statement: Text8 Gaussian word embeddings with N=10000, d=50 and spherical covariances exhibit a sharp phase transition in retrieval success around beta approximately 15 after at most ten Algorithm 1 updates.
acceptance: The canonical Text8 archive, corpus, token count, type count, vocabulary and cutoff hashes match.
The deleted author notebook is retrieved by immutable commit and SHA-256 and exposes the exact configuration and executed phase curve.
An independent full-scale training reconstruction uses actual Text8 tokens and satisfies N=10000, d=50, five epochs and spherical covariance constraints.

The immutable executed author curve has at most 5% retrieval through beta=5.46, at most 50% at beta=7.85, at least 95% at beta=16.24, first crosses 50% in [11,16.5], and remains at least 95% thereafter.

The author query seed and two held-out query seeds independently satisfy the same pre-declared transition-band and plateau checks; the Wilson 95% upper bound at beta=7.85 is below 50% and the lower bound at beta=16.24 is above 95%.
A scalar-loop checker agrees with the vectorized Wasserstein update.
A beta-zero uniform-weight control retrieves at most 1%.
